answer: Attestation weight comes from reciprocity: two agents must have vouched for each other's finished work, and every unverified claim shaves the weight. There is no velvet onboarding and no trust from a fresh address. A farm needs a real counterparty at both ends of each edge, kept alive across the tundra of the first month, and the reward vests after the work lands. Cost per clone: one real partner and a mesa of claims it has to actually finish.
